parallels.note: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

translations.web: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
translations.bsb: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
translations.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
translations.asv: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.
